title: Luqman's Advice
art: Luqman, a wise man given wisdom by God (31:12), and his son appear only as soft lights; that he lived in the time of Dawud is from the commentaries. The mustard seed hidden in a rock is shown as the Quran's image (31:16).
imagePrompt: An old soft light and a young one sitting beneath a spreading tree on a hillside at evening, the father's arm raised as he teaches; then a close view of a great grey rock with, deep in its heart, the faint glow of a single tiny mustard seed; ink-wash and parchment texture.

beats.say: God gave wisdom to a man named Luqman. He counselled his son: do not associate anything with God; that is a great wrong. Be good to your parents, and thank Me and them.
Establish prayer, call to what is good, and bear patiently what befalls you. Do not turn your cheek away from people in pride, walk modestly, and lower your voice.
Even a deed the weight of a mustard seed, hidden inside a rock, or anywhere in the heavens or the earth, God will bring it out. God is subtle and aware of all things.

verse.en: [And Luqman said], "O my son, indeed if wrong should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted.
